Month in brief

Planned breaking changes to ASIM KQL functions used by Microsoft Sentinel for Developers leads 1759 Defender updates

April 2026 recorded 628 new, 1090 updated, 36 removed Microsoft Defender documentation changes and 5 relevant Message Center announcements. The most active areas were Sentinel, Endpoint, Defender XDR.

  • Defender XDR · Hunting and detection
    Planned breaking changes to ASIM KQL functions used by Microsoft Sentinel for Developers

    Microsoft Sentinel for Developers will have planned breaking changes to ASIM KQL functions, updating _Im_ProcessCreate to use targetusername_has instead of targetusername. Organizations should review and update queries by May 25 or later to avoid disruptions. Rollout dates will be announced later.

  • IoT · General
    OT threat monitoring in enterprise security operation center (SOC) teams - Microsoft Defender for IoT

    Added Microsoft Defender documentation in defender-for-iot-azure/organizations/concept-sentinel-integration.md.

  • Sentinel · Cloud and workloads
    Sap Solution Security Content

    Updated Microsoft Defender documentation in sentinel/sap/sap-solution-security-content.md.

  • Endpoint · Vulnerabilities and exposure
    Migrating from a non-Microsoft HIPS to attack surface reduction rules

    Updated Microsoft Defender documentation in defender-endpoint/migrating-asr-rules.md.

  • Exposure Management · Vulnerabilities and exposure
    Predefined classifications - Microsoft Security Research

    Updated Microsoft Defender documentation in exposure-management/predefined-classification-rules-and-levels.md.

For Defender administrators

Review the linked Microsoft Learn changes that apply to your managed platforms, policies, applications, and rollout plans. The archive preserves the source diff for verification.
